subject: ci: fix the main merge-queue flakes (Launchpad retries, no model re-downloads, App checks race) (#4245)
summary: Fixes the main merge-queue flakes by adding a retry.sh helper for Launchpad apt steps with exponential backoff, reusing downloaded models in test pulls instead of re-downloading from Hugging Face on every run, and fixing the App checks 25c/25d Playwright race condition by waiting for the Chat tab switch — bundling three related CI fixes (#4246 and #4248 merged unchanged so they all land through the queue together).
verdict_reason: Three separate CI fixes bundled into one PR merged without re-approval from the original reviewer after post-approval commits were added, and the author self-resolved CodeRabbit's findings without another reviewer sign-off.
